sources.summary: The commission consisted of designing the new entrance to a recreational and sports campground, giving it the required scale. Through a 3.30 x 3.30-meter grid, the project aimed to organize the entry, contrasting with the morphology of the campground, which had grown somewhat haphazardly over time.
